name: Vigilant Brotherhood
text: Army marker for the Stormcast Eternals Vigilant Brotherhood. Its battle traits, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: Shield of Azyr
text: Once per turn, in your hero phase, pick any friendly unit. It has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

name: Storm Charge
text: Once per battle, at the start of your charge phase, pick a friendly unit that is not in combat. This turn it can use Charge abilities even though it used a Run ability.

name: Strike Where Needed
text: Once per battle, when a friendly unit declares a Retreat, it suffers no mortal damage for retreating and can still use Charge abilities later this turn.

name: Blaze of Glory
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, pick a friendly unit in combat. Until the end of the phase, each time a model of that unit is slain, roll a dice. On a 4+, an enemy unit in combat with it suffers 1 mortal damage.

name: Morrda's Talon
text: The bearer's Hallowed Greataxe has Crit (Mortal).

name: Quicksilver Draught
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, the bearer has Strike-first for the rest of that phase.

name: Null Pendant
text: Once per battle, at the end of any turn, roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as the bearer. For each 2+, subtract the roll from that unit's control score this turn.

name: Deliver Judgement
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, pick a friendly non-Hero unit wholly within 12" of this unit. This phase that unit can use 2 Fight abilities; after it uses the first, it has Strike-last for the rest of the phase.

name: Plan the Attack
text: In your hero phase, pick an objective you do not control. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units' combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting that objective.

name: Cleansing Fires
text: In your hero phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit and make a chanting roll of 3+. If it works, roll a dice for each model in that unit; each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal damage on it.

name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
text: While this unit's Gryph-crow is on the battlefield, this unit has Ward (5+). If you roll an unmodified 1 on a ward roll for this unit, the Gryph-crow is removed from the battlefield.

name: Heralds of Righteousness
text: This unit rolls 1 extra dice when it makes a charge roll.

name: Skirmishers
text: This unit's coherency range is 2" instead of 1/2".

name: Stalwart Defenders
text: Add 3 to this unit's control score while it contests an objective that is wholly within friendly territory.
